status: design proposal; not implemented in the desktop executable
reference: original gallery #5 dark spatial module field; #3/#4 light material and angled layered containers

identity.module: one canonical project module ID with source anchors and a revision
identity.backgroundTile: a view of a real module ID, or an explicitly labeled aggregate of IDs
identity.foregroundMember: another focused view of the same ID; shared code is not duplicated
identity.originAnchor: dim position marker retained while a module is focused
identity.featureAssembly: a selection-specific composition with membership roles, relationship types and evidence

layers.name: preview
layers.content: captured or reconstructed behavior views; runtime observation optional and labeled

layers.name: whole project
layers.content: real project modules, assets and shared definitions

layers.name: selected feature
layers.content: relevant constituent roles, source, properties, concise source-backed AI rationale

layers.name: agent work
layers.content: existing CLI/MCP mode or API-key agent mode using the same project context

layers.name: hierarchy
layers.content: search, semantic hierarchy, keyboard navigation and focus reset

states.visible: persistent preview, module neighborhoods, compact hierarchy
picked element and source mapping confidence
states.work: resolve module IDs and source revision; distinguish static links, observed evidence and inferred links

states.visible: selected representations move from stable background anchors into role-based assembly slots
input, rules, state and output; expand source or meaningful AI notes on demand
draft values and modeled before/after effects with affected module IDs
concrete source diff, source revision, impacts, validation results or pending status

states.work: reindex changed source; update module records and stale evidence; preserve layout identity where possible

states.visible: representations return to the same anchors; no change to source files from animation alone

proposedMotion.intent: animate a bounded set of representative functional modules, not every leaf dependency
proposedMotion.sharedModule: retain canonical ID and origin marker; expose other users on demand
proposedMotion.reducedMotion: instant focus or a short fade, with the same content and keyboard access
proposedMotion.note: timing is an initial design value, not a measured performance result

scale.far: semantic aggregate stacks with actual membership counts
scale.middle: representative modules with compact role and icon/thumbnail
scale.near: selected composition and directly relevant relations
scale.detail: front-facing source, properties, evidence, AI rationale and change review
scale.largeSelection: show functional subgroup representatives with a count and drill-down; do not animate thousands of individual cards
scale.implementationCandidates: incremental stable layout, view culling, level of detail and instanced distant tiles; benchmark on real projects before performance claims

agent.local: existing CLI connects to project context through MCP; illustrative screenshots are not a claim of a completed Codex integration
agent.api: integrated agent uses provider/model configuration and an API key to search/read/propose/validate with the same project tools
agent.context: selected module IDs, source revision, retrieved records and affected features
agent.change: proposal and explicit review before applying source changes
agent.credentials: masked settings in designs; runtime key handling is outside this design task

rationale: concise purpose and verifiable design summaries on meaningful implementation modules; no hidden chain of thought and no mandatory essays on simple assets
